deck_title: Anan: The AI Operating System For Real Estate Execution
deck_subtitle: One system for buyer-side AI, financing, broker and developer workspace execution, and market visibility
simple_company_description: Anan is an AI-first real estate operating system with a buyer-side assistant and a workspace agent for brokers and developers.
positioning: Anan uses AI to connect buyer demand, financing, and workspace operations inside one operating system.

official_sources.name: How to Pitch Your Company
official_sources.principle: Explain the company in very simple language.

official_sources.name: How to Design a Better Pitch Deck
official_sources.principle: Keep the deck easy to remember and focused on obvious, important ideas.

official_sources.name: Practical Design: Pitching
official_sources.principle: Build the pitch around a few strong facts instead of maximum information.

research_basis.investor_goal: Create belief and follow-up interest, not a complete feature explanation.

writing_method: Translate code truth into a startup thesis.
Add a why-now story for 2026 and agentic real estate.
Add evidence that is either code-grounded or explicitly founder-supplied.
Leave traction and business proof as structured blanks when not yet provided.

buyer_side_assistant.entry_point: The mobile app opens directly into a chat-first buyer assistant workspace.
technical_truth: The mobile app is backed by live Convex wiring.
The mobile app has explicit fallback handling during development.
The buyer assistant contract includes structured bank-offer, mortgage-check, loan-calculator, and handoff cards.
The backend includes finance agents and bank-bundle tools for financing analysis.

workspace.description: The workspace is an execution surface whose primary entry point is a workspace assistant at /ws.
assistant_home_truth: The primary authenticated /ws route renders the workspace dashboard and treats it as the main entry point.
The dashboard README describes /ws as a workspace assistant surface.
The workspace assistant canvas renders a landing state, active conversation, and composer as the main screen.
The workspace assistant prompt explicitly prioritizes projects, offers, CRM, organizations, invitations, inbox, and actionable next steps.
agent_actions_supported: prepare offer-oriented asks from the first screen
compare broker performance through suggested prompts
analyze market activity through suggested prompts
handle project deletion confirmations when role permissions allow
technical_truth: The web workspace uses audience-aware server composition to dispatch broker and developer behavior.
The broader platform already spans mobile, web workspace, admin, and backend zones.
The workspace assistant UI is built to render structured AG UI components for draft, insight, and execution states.

current_product_truth.one_screen_vision: Anan is building one operating logic where AI intake, workspace execution, broker help, and team workflow stay connected instead of being split across disconnected tools.

comparison_categories.difference: Anan is not only conversation; it routes work into structured execution.
Anan is not only record keeping; it starts from AI intake and moves into workflow.
Anan is not only a mortgage or bank-comparison flow; financing is connected to property context, qualification, and handoff.
Anan is not only listing exposure; it connects buyers, brokers, and developers inside one operating system.
Anan is not a narrow broker tool; it coordinates both broker and developer execution.
Anan is not only search; it links search, assistant context, handoff, and workspace action.

timing_thesis: AI is moving from assistive chat into systems that can hold workflow context.
Real estate is still fragmented across channels, teams, and manual handoffs.
That gap creates an opening for an agentic operating layer.
2026 is a good time to define the standard before the category hardens.
why_now.note: This is strategic framing, not a claim of market dominance.

code_grounded: The product already spans assistant intake and workspace execution.
The main workspace opens with an operator assistant rather than a passive home dashboard.
The assistant and workspace are part of one system rather than disconnected tools.
The buyer-side product already includes financing, bank comparison, and handoff logic.
The workspace already maps to operational categories that matter in real-estate execution.
Direct workspace assistant commands already exist for projects, offers, and client/CRM workflows.
The workspace assistant UI already includes draft, approval, insight, and execution surfaces.
founder_supplied_draft: Founder edge: technical builder who codes the product directly.
Partner edge: deep real-estate experience and network.
Market edge: grounded focus on Saudi and Jeddah real-estate behavior.
Competitive edge: move fast and become the operating standard early.

slide_outline.title: The broken real-estate workflow
canonical_talking_points: Real-estate execution is fragmented across channels, handoffs, and disconnected tools.
That fragmentation slows qualification and weakens visibility.
The result is lost context between demand, execution, and follow-through.

slide_outline.title: What Anan is in one sentence
canonical_talking_points: Anan is an AI-first real estate operating system.
It combines a buyer-side assistant with a workspace agent for brokers and developers.
The system connects demand capture, execution, and visibility.

slide_outline.title: The buyer-side AI assistant
canonical_talking_points: The mobile product opens directly into a chat-first buyer assistant.
The assistant already supports search, property detail, bank-aware finance guidance, mortgage estimation, and advisor handoff.
This is the intake and qualification layer of the system, not a generic chatbot.

slide_outline.title: The workspace agent as the main operating screen
canonical_talking_points: The main workspace does not begin as a passive dashboard; it begins as an operator assistant.
From the first screen, users can ask for projects, offers, CRM context, broker analysis, and other operational work.
The assistant can surface structured drafts, approvals, insights, and execution states rather than only plain-text answers.
The wider workspace still contains projects, offers, CRM, inbox, market, overview, and settings behind that agent surface.

slide_outline.title: How buyer AI, financing, workspace, and broker support fit together
canonical_talking_points: AI captures demand and keeps context on the buyer side.
Financing and bank comparison stay inside the same buyer journey instead of living in a separate flow.
The workspace agent holds context and routes operational work on the broker and developer side.
Broker support and collaboration help move work forward instead of losing it between channels.

slide_outline.title: Why this is bigger than a point solution
canonical_talking_points: Anan is not solving one narrow task.
It ties together intake, execution, collaboration, and market visibility.
That makes the product closer to an operating system than a single-feature tool.

slide_outline.title: Category comparison and why Anan is different
canonical_talking_points: Anan is not just a chatbot, CRM, finance tool, marketplace, broker tool, or search app.
It combines assistant entry, financing flow, workspace-agent execution, broker coordination, and market visibility.
That combination is the key differentiation.

slide_outline.title: Why now in 2026 and why agentic real estate
canonical_talking_points: AI can now hold more context and support real workflow movement.
Real estate is still operationally fragmented.
That creates a timing window for an agentic operating layer.

slide_outline.title: Why this team can build it
canonical_talking_points: The product already reflects a connected assistant-plus-workspace thesis.

slide_outline.title: The investor thesis
canonical_talking_points: Anan starts with AI on both sides of the product, then turns demand, financing, and workspace operations into execution through one operating system.
Each new workflow strengthens the same product core.
Insert traction, business proof, and fundraising details here when available.

writing_guardrails: Do not imply future features are already fully deployed.
Do not use engineering jargon unless it improves investor clarity.
Do not describe Anan as only one product surface or one tool.
Do not present founder-supplied draft claims as code-grounded facts.
